title: The Stoat's universal Time AI: one set of trampoline autopilot rows for Slingshot I1-I4, grown from every Stoat genome - with the AI nose lead ON
goal: The lead-on twin of slingshot-stoat-time: the same search, the same seeds and genomes, with the pilot-side AI nose lead switched on in the model (nose_lead 2.5; Tools/Build/ai_nose_lead.py, the model of AIPilot.NoseLeadGain from PR #1786, which the game ships at 0). the Slingshot model flies the fleet nose lag (slingshot_stoat_sim), so only the lead is added. Garrett's plan (REGATTA_BALANCE_PLAN.md, the direction since 2026-11-06) judges every hull and every course on AIs that do not overshoot ring mouths, so each hull's drive is searched again with the lead on and compared with its lead-off twin on the same courses: the lead-on winner is the drive proposed for the day Yash turns the switch on. Run by hand until Compute is back (Shombith paused it 2026-11-06): /mnt/project-files/regatta-training/local_run.py, two independent restarts (labels B, C). Parent goal: The Stoat's universal Time AI (Docs/AI_SYSTEM/AI_PLAN.md step time-arcade): ONE set of StoatSlingConfig autopilot rows (aiSlingMinTurnDegrees, aiSlingIntervalSeconds, aiSlingMinDistance, trampolineAiTurnScale, autopilotHold01 and, where StoatSlingExecutor.AutopilotTrampoline reads it, aiWarpMinDistance) that races all four Slingshot intensities well on the trampoline kit. Its first generation is every Stoat sling genome (StoatSlingConfig_Slingshot, the hull's StoatSlingConfig, StoatSlingConfig_Regatta where it exists, StoatSlingConfig_Warpline) and mutations of each; the loss is the four intensities' scores together (mean + 0.5 x the worst), raced on Tools/Build/slingshot_stoat_sim.py (the trampoline ported from the C#, every kit number read from the ref). RUN BY HAND until Froglet Compute is switched back on (paused by Shombith, 2026-11-06): /mnt/project-files/regatta-training/local_run.py runs it locally and publishes nothing. Measured 2026-11-06 (Docs/Reports/SLINGSHOT_STOAT_AI.md): on Yash's 30 u shell no turn-press rule beats cruising (about 139-150 s a race), the shipped rows run 145-173 s; with the warp press a hand grid found 65-92 s.
asked_by: Garrett 2026-11-06 (regatta balancing, BRIEFS.md section 2): train the Stoat's Slingshot AI. Yash owns the Stoat, its kit and its AI (MINIGAME_TRAINING_PLAN.md section 8).
area_owner: Yash (the Stoat, Slingshot and the Stoat's AI)
promote: Only after Yash turns AIPilot.NoseLeadGain on (PR #1786) and its editor check passes; then as the parent's rule, against the parent's winner raced WITH the lead: A PROPOSAL for the AI owner (Yash), any of the core four approving: race the team's best against the shipped rows and every genome on 12 FRESH courses per intensity (seedbase 1001); keep it only if it finishes as many as the best of them on every intensity and its composite is lower. Then it becomes StoatSlingConfig_Slingshot's rows (AIModeTuning.ForPilot), written with the learner's writer (Tools/Build/learn_drives_from_flights.py's asset writer), never by hand, and StoatSlingTests' pinned aiWarpMinDistance 0 moves with it. The editor check goes in Docs/UNITY_VERIFICATION_CHECKLIST.md (AI Stoats race Slingshot at I1-I4; none flies far off the course).
